Hi all.

So I just put my first commercial VR project online.http://entreegallery.com/w/_flash/Tourweaver_samb.html A VR Art show in a web browser linked to ecommerce. It is for a local gallery that I do tech work for and we figured it would be a great way to showcase some of an artist work.

I used old technology; Flash based 360 static panoramas, to build it, but I think it works fairly well as a tool for this specific medium. I took the panoramas using a Nikon DSLR (all on automatic) set on a tripod that had degree markers set in the pan head. Then, took the photos in three passes (floor, wall , ceiling) at about 33 degrees apart at about 2k resolution each. For something like, 20-25 or so pictures

Then, used the auto panomaker in photoshop CS6 to stitch the photos together (then had to do a little manual editing on the stitching, but very little)

Then used an old buggy tool called Easypano Virtual Tour Makers to set up the initial web/browser config files and set hotspots from the art on the walls back to a woocommerce/wordpress setup that has the detailed art photos and description.

I would have preferred to use an old Japanese web based pano plyer called: Ryubin Flash Panorama Player, as it had better feature configurability, but it didn't support hotlinking very well...

Overall there are some things I still need to work on and will be tinkering with over the next day or two.....

The hotlinking to the "product page" is cludgy and would like to refine that interaction. The start up controls are off. The "turn off music player" for the embedded music only plays in some browsers The pano image needs some colour correction.

Overall I'm fairly happy with the whole solution as a first time try. Would love anyone's productive feedback on how to make the next one better. .
